map.在基色上按比例混入白色得到 tint（更亮），混入黑色得到 shade（更暗）。: Mix white into the base color by ratio to get a tint (lighter), or black to get a shade (darker). Specify the number of steps to generate a harmonious set of light/dark swatches for button and background layering.
map.tint = C·(1−t) + 255·t；shade = C·(1−t) +: tint = C·(1−t) + 255·t; shade = C·(1−t) + 0·t (t is the mix ratio, 0 ≤ t ≤ 1).
map.按线性混色：tint 是在基色上按比例混入白色得到更亮的色，shade 是混入黑: Linear mixing: a tint mixes white into the base by ratio for a lighter color, a shade mixes black for a darker one; generate a full set of light/dark swatches at fixed steps for layering buttons, backgrounds, and borders.
map.tint 是基色混入白色（t→1 越亮），shade 是基色混入黑色（越暗），线: A tint mixes white into the base (t→1 is lighter), a shade mixes black (darker); linear mixing gives a smooth transition.
